array contents lost after mutation.argument: Append results, later loop receivers and propagated array contents omit values inserted by Ruby. The array send transfer returns Array of the receiver element type without joining the argument. The subsequent sequence refinement only handles direct Array bindings; it does not retroactively repair the send result or supply loop-carried values.

hash contents lost after update or merge.argument: Inserted keys, values and aliases are absent from downstream hash types. The hash-index refinement explicitly preserves the old key type, so an empty seed with Bottom keys stays empty-only. Hash#merge returns the receiver key/value types without joining its argument.
